[[Iceblood's Warstaff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Spafrod Iceblood]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sacnoth Valley]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Water Magic]] spells (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Water Magic]] spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Astral Staff]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[staves]]:
**[[Water Staff]] from collectors [[Rylan Paval]], [[Merin Trollsbane]], [[Claw Tallfeather]], or [[Leon]] or crafters [[Manzo]], [[Mathilde]], or [[Theodosus]]
**[[Lotus Staff]] from collector [[Artor Bobani Kiroz]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Adept]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
OR
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[staves]]:
**[[Tidal Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]

**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]

==Notes==
*The two identical Halves Casting Time mods combine to a 36% chance to cast the spell in half the time.
{{see|40/20/20}}

==Trivia==
*Before the [[Game updates/20080529|May 29, 2008 update]], Spafrod Iceblood incorrectly dropped [[Lord Glacius' Staff]] instead of this one.
*Before the [[Game updates/20080605|June 05, 2008 update]], the two HCT (20%) effects showed up as one HCT (40%) effect, which would actually have been something different. ''(See first note)''
